## Workload

During the review period, Marcus Bell reads 1032 sets over 488 rostered hours. This represents a recorded throughput of 2.1 per hour. The workload was considered alongside the available rostered time and the expected consistency of grading activity. The figures provide a summary of the volume completed and the rate at which the work was undertaken.

## Quality

A sample of 84 sets was checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 73.8. This result was considered in the context of the checked work and the overall grading activity. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent decisions and clarify the expected approach. The review was completed by Priya Anand, with the workload and quality information considered together.
